invariants.evidence: One SWAP kernel remains authoritative; the frozen provider seam is runtime composition only.
No files, formats, paths or parsing enter kernel or provider semantics.
Accepted water transfer, external thermal metadata, immutable enthalpy parameters and energy result remain separate data categories.
External binding is candidate-scoped metadata and explicitly not persistent continuation state.
Provider requests/responses may be worker/evaluation local and require no per-column permanent scratch.
Scalar and batched provider composition are both allowed without changing the logical contract.
Provider metadata cannot authorize acceptance or commit and rejected/superseded candidate bindings cannot publish accepted energy.
No reconstruction solve is allowed; a provider answer is obtained from the current candidate request.
Requests carry generic finite t0/t1 and use sample t1 as the frozen current-reference quadrature point; no calendar assumption exists.
No midnight/day coupling window assumption is introduced.
The seam is explicitly compatible with runtime/coupler composition and transactional candidate lifecycle.
Groundwater H/q interface authority remains mod_groundwater_coupling_contract; EB-I16 neither changes nor duplicates it.
Provider never owns or alters Q; the EB-I13 candidate remains the sole SWAP-side water-transfer authority.
No interface sensitivity semantics are changed.
External thermal lookup requires no additional SWAP physical run; batching is permitted.
Provider contract is batchable and adds no heavy solver instance per logical column.
No MODFLOW cell identity or tile fraction is visible to the SWAP-side provider seam.
Deep-vadose may be an external donor source but its routing/state remain outside SWAP.
Thermal metadata cannot move or duplicate water; transition mass accounting remains owned by component/runtime contracts.
Any soil-water solver producing the public accepted bottom thermal candidate can use the same provider seam.
Existing EB-I04 enthalpy law and EB-I13/I15 physics are reused rather than duplicated.
The contract references only public carrier/evaluator semantics and no HeadCalc internals.
External donor temperature is physical boundary metadata; batching/caching choices remain execution policy.
Provider cost must be attributable and batching is explicitly permitted to avoid unbounded MultiSWAP stalls.
No reference physics is removed or weakened; current EB-I14/I15 rule remains the reference accounting path.
Complete, unavailable, invalid, identity-mismatched and stale-provenance states are required to be diagnosable.
No provider is required for candidates without external inward samples and no permanent thermal history is introduced.
Source mapping for groundwater, deep-vadose or other components is explicitly runtime/coupler responsibility.
No implicit .swp, daily, midnight, MODFLOW or source-type dependency is introduced.
This file records an explicit disposition for every one of the thirty architecture invariants.
